description: Render a service blueprint as a self-contained HTML page. Supports two modes: (1) classic Shostack single-actor blueprint — user action, frontstage, backstage, support, evidence, pain/delight; (2) two-actor HI-loop blueprint — when `actors` is supplied, renders two swim lanes with a line of interaction between them (e.g. customer ↔ lawyer, patient ↔ doctor, buyer ↔ agent). Each actor gets their own actions, frontstage (what they see), and evidence. Optionally accepts an ideal-state to render side-by-side with the current state.

actors.description: Omit for classic single-actor Shostack blueprint. Provide to render a two-swim-lane HI-loop blueprint with a line of interaction between the two sides.

a.description: Actor A label (default: 'User'). Use when you want to name the first side (e.g. 'Customer', 'Patient').

b.description: Actor B label (e.g. 'Lawyer', 'Doctor', 'Agent'). Presence of this field switches to two-actor layout.

current.description: The current-state blueprint as an array of steps

actor_b.description: Only used when `actors.b` is provided. Captures the other side of the interaction.

action.description: What actor B does in this step

evidence.description: Artifact actor B has — case file, notes, record

frontstage.description: What actor B sees — their own UI, tools, views

backstage.description: What neither actor sees directly — shared systems, internal processes, back-office work

delight.description: Designed moment of delight at this step (shown as green callout)

evidence.description: In single-actor: artifact user receives. In two-actor: artifact actor A has.

frontstage.description: In single-actor: what the user SEES (UI, agent greeting). In two-actor: what actor A sees.

pain_point.description: Known pain point at this step (shown as red callout)

user_action.description: In single-actor: what the user does. In two-actor: what actor A does.

ideal.description: Optional ideal-state blueprint — if provided, output shows current AND ideal side-by-side

service_name.description: Name of the service (e.g. 'Free trial signup', 'Client intake', 'Restaurant reservation')

subtitle.description: Short description or context line under the title

name: generate_service_blueprint
